chunks: And He is God, my Lord, and I do not associate any one with my Lord.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Wa la ushriku bi Rabbi ahadan' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of the Young Men of the Cave, this verse marks the protagonist's decisive break from polytheism, serving as a concise creedal declaration of exclusive devotion to Allah. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a model of *Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah* (monotheism of worship), illustrating how true faith necessitates rejecting all false deities while maintaining a personal, direct relationship with the Divine Lord.
